# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

The uploaded corpus is very large but a majority of the clips are **not genuine sales calls** — they are internal logistics chatter (vehicle/Porter bookings, gate/security coordination, loading, driver instructions), accounts/collection follow-ups, Diwali-gift-distribution coordination with dealers, and short "hello, wrong number" fragments. After filtering these out, the real sales-relevant material that remains is a moderate-sized set of:

- **Inbound customer enquiry calls** (mostly cold/online leads asking for roofing sheet rates, thickness, color, accessories).
- **Existing dealer/fabricator repeat-order calls** where detailed cutting lengths, bends, and quantities are dictated over the phone.
- **Scheme/price negotiation calls** with sub-dealers/retailers for screws and welding rods.
- A few **B2B/industrial enquiries** (polycarbonate sheet, puff panel, MS channel/purlin) that didn't convert because of MOQ or customization limits.

This KB is built only from those calls. Given the mixed quality of the corpus, some pricing lines are ambiguous or contradictory in the source audio (e.g., same JSW thickness quoted at two different rates in two calls) — these are flagged below rather than reconciled, since we must not invent a "correct" number.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing & Structures (factory base: **Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai**) sells/fabricates:

1. **Metal (profile/corrugated) roofing sheets** — the core product line.
   - Brands mentioned: **JSW Color On Plus**, **JSW Pragathi**, **JSW Radiance**, **JSW Silver On Plus**, **Asian Indira Dhanush**.
   - Thicknesses in active use: **0.45 mm, 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.6 mm** (0.7 mm explicitly *not* stocked — "அவ்வளவுக்கு 7 mm-ல இல்ல Sir 0.6 mm-ல sky blue available-ஆ இருக்கு" [we don't have 0.7mm, 0.6mm sky blue is available]).
   - Colors: sky blue, off-white/half white, royal blue, grey/dark green ("Kali Shelt Green"), terracotta/red.
   - Sold both as **profile/trapezoidal sheets** and as **plain/flat coil-cut sheets** (rolls) by width (1ft/2ft/3ft/4ft) and running length.
2. **Roofing accessories**: L-flash, ridge, gutter, cutter (end-cap/bend pieces), barge board, crimp — all cut to custom diagrams/dimensions the customer sends.
3. **Puff insulated sandwich panels** (metal-foam-metal) for roof/wall cladding, e.g. 50 mm thickness, used for cold-room/AC-room type applications — quoted separately from normal roofing.
4. **Polycarbonate (FRP) sheets** — brand **Lexon**, thickness 1.5 mm / 1.8 mm / 2 mm / 10 mm "clear," standard max length ~15 feet; custom widths possible via manual pressing, lengths are not.
5. **MS structural items**: JSW-brand **channels/purlins** (e.g., 125/65 channel) — handled via a separate contact/line, not core SKU knowledge for the generalist telecaller.
6. **Screws** (Tata Agri-branded self-drilling/self-tapping): common SKUs — 1 inch, 2 inch (50/55 mm), M8-55mm full-thread self-welding screw, rust-free 2-inch screw.
7. **Welding rods** (Tata brand, and a cheaper "Rasi" brand) sold to hardware sub-dealers with monthly slab schemes.
8. Products explicitly **NOT made/stocked**, with staff redirecting the caller: **tile-profile sheets** (customer told to check with "Amar"/"Everlast" machine owners), **liner sheets** ("நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லையே" [we don't make that at all] — customer told to check Arumuga Steel), **UPVC sheets**, **plain MS corrugated sheet**, **GI sheet (80/120 GSM spangle type)** (team had to check internally since they normally only supply metal roofing, not true GI).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

> Note: multiple calls quote the *same* brand/thickness at different rates — this reflects real day-to-day price movement/market-specific quoting in the source audio, not an error in this KB.

- **JSW Color On Plus, 0.47 mm** — quoted at **₹420 + GST/sq.m** in one call, and **₹445 + GST/sq.m** in several others.
- **JSW Pragathi, 0.47 mm (color on plus)** — **₹445 + GST/sq.m**.
- **JSW Radiance** — **₹435 + GST/sq.m**, also expressed as **₹118/kg + GST**.
- **Asian Indira Dhanush, 0.45 mm** — **₹370 + GST/sq.m**; a later call gives **Pragathi sky blue at ₹410 + GST/sq.m = ₹484 incl. 18% GST**.
- **10 mm thickness, "clear"** sheet — **₹61 + tax per sq.ft**.
